simplecontainers.title: Simple Containers
simplecontainers.option.enabled.tooltip: Draw container screens in the Simple style: a box in the block's colour and a light inventory box. Off = every screen exactly Vanilla. Client only. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.chest.too: Generic chest screens (1-6 rows: chest, double chest, barrel, ender chest, copper chests, chest boats and minecarts) in the block's colour. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.shulker_b: Shulker box screen in the box's dye colour (purple without dye). Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.hopper.to: Hopper screen in iron grey. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.dispenser: Dispenser and dropper screen in cobblestone grey. Default: on.
Crafting table screen in light wood with a big result slot and an engraved arrow. The recipe book button stays. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.furnace.t: Furnace screen in stone grey: the fuel slot shows the burn time as flames, heat waves over it, the arrow fills with the cooking progress. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.blast_fur: Blast furnace screen in dark iron with brighter flames in the fuel slot. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.smoker.to: Smoker screen in smoked brown with smoke curls over the fuel slot. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.brewing_s: Brewing stand screen in one grey box: the blaze powder slot shows the fuel left, pipes lead to the bottles, bubbles rise while brewing. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.beacon.to: Beacon screen in glass teal: power fields with pyramid and star symbols, raised effect buttons, check and cross. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.enchantin: Enchanting table screen in red: the three offers as sunk rows with lapis gems for their cost. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.crafter.t: Crafter screen in deepslate grey: big result slot, a redstone dust sign that glows red while powered, an engraved arrow and engraved crosses on disabled slots. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.mount.too: Mount inventory (horse, donkey, mule, llama, camel and their kin) in saddle leather with a stitched seam; saddle and armor slots show engraved outlines, the animal stands in a sunk field. Default: on.
Nautilus inventory in the same saddle leather as the other mounts. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.anvil.too: Anvil screen in iron grey: sunk name field, engraved plus and arrow, the XP cost (symbol + levels) inside the box. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.grindston: Grindstone screen in stone grey with an engraved grinding wheel and arrow; an XP symbol shows when enchantments come off. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.stonecutt: Stonecutter screen in the block's colour: recipe tiles and scroll bar as raised tiles in a sunk field. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.loom.tool: Loom screen in wood brown: pattern tiles and scroll bar as raised tiles, one box with a light inventory part. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.cartograp: Cartography table screen in dark wood: engraved plus and arrow, sunk map field. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.smithing_: Smithing table screen in dark red with an engraved arrow and a sunk armor stand field (also SimpleBuilding's smithing screen with recipe book). Default: on.
Trading screen in green: offer list as raised tiles (the chosen offer sunk), engraved trade arrows, sunk XP bar. Default: on.
simplecontainers.option.screen.player_in: Your own inventory (E) as one light box: armor and shield slots, sunk field behind your player model, 2x2 crafting with an engraved arrow. Recipe book and other mods' buttons stay. Default: on.
